propositions: A new generator script must produce two fully-generated markdown documents (config-reference.md and security.md) by reading config schema, deprecation registry, and secret-name inventory, while leaving docs/config.md untouched and preserving all its consumers.

The generated documents must include registry-derived tables (lifecycle, precedence, secrets) and curated narrative sections (observability, subprocess limits, behavior deltas, native refresh), with top-of-file banners announcing generation.

A --check drift mode must detect stale generated docs and return nonzero on mismatch, with newline normalization to handle CRLF checkouts, exercised by a pytest suite running under make test without CI dependency.

Generated docs must be registered in test_generated_surface_markers.py and docs/README.md, with topic-coverage tests verifying anchors exist for all required topics (precedence, source, lifecycle, rotation, refresh, observability, subprocess, behavior deltas, MCP/CLI exposure).
docs/config.md must remain byte-unchanged; a test must prove the generator never targets config.md so that all existing content-asserting suites and anchor deep links continue to function.
